Taxes Committee
Thursday, Apri! 27, 2023
7:00 PM or At the Call of the Chair, Room G-15, Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator D. Scott Dibble,
Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Kari Dziedzic, Senator Grant Hauschild, Senator Jeremy
R. Miller, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam, Senator Bill Weber

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 9:25 a.m. Adjourned for Recess: 10:39 a.m.
Return from Recess: 11:30 a.m. Adjourned for Recess: 12:17 p.m. Return from Recess: 6:43 p.m.

Call to Order

Quorum is Present.

Members Attending Remotely: Senator Dziedzic (all day), Senator Miller (at 6:43 p.m.)
Minutes from 4.27.23 were approved as presented.

S.F. 1811: Senator Rest: Tax provisions modifications.

Testifiers:

Joanna Bayers, Legislative Direction, Department of Revenue

Melissa Tape, Attorney, Department of Revenue

Eric Willette, Director of Tax Research, Department of Revenue

(zoom) Fred Nicely, Senior Tax Counsel, Council on State Taxation

Senator Farnsworth

Senator Klein moved the A29 Technical Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A29 Technical
Amendment was adopted.

Senator Klein moved the A32 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A32 Amendment was
adopted.

Senator Klein moved the A35 Amendment. A roll call was requested. Senator Klein moved the A36
Amendment to the A35 Amendment. Senator Klein moved an author's amendment to the A36
Amendment. On line 1.8, strike “an additional”. On line 1.9, insert “a” before “tax”, and after “tax”
strike “of three percent”. Senator Klein requested a roll call, and a roll call was granted. With a vote of

5 ayes, 4 nays, and 1 abstention, the A36 Amendment to the A35 Amendment was adopted.

Senator Klein requested a roll call on the A35 Amendment as amended. With a vote of 4 ayes and 6
nays, the motion did not prevail. The A35 Amendment was not adopted as amended.

Senator Nelson moved the A31 Amendment. Senator Nelson requested a roll call for the A31
Amendment.

Senator Klein moved the A37 Amendment to the A31 Amendment. Senator Klein requested a roll
call, and a roll call was granted. With a call vote of 5 ayes, 4 nays, and 1 abstention, the A37
Amendment to the A31 Amendment was adopted.


Senator Nelson moved that the A31 Amendment be withdrawn as amended by the A37 Amendment.

Senator Hauschild moved the A39 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A39 Amendment was
adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A28 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call
was granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes, 6 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A28
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Weber moved the A12 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes, 5 nays, and 1 abstention, the motion did not prevail, and the
A12 Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A24 Amendment. Senator Drazkowski requested a roll call, and a roll
call was granted. With a roll call vote of 2 ayes and 8 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A24
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Drazkowski moved the A23 Amendment. Senator Drazkowski requested a roll call, and a roll
call was granted. With a roll call vote of 10 ayes and 0 nays, the motion prevailed, and the A23
Amendment was adopted.

Senator Weber moved the A4 Amendment. Senator Weber requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 5 ayes and 5 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A4 Amendment
was not adopted.

Senator Nelson moved the A26 Amendment. Senator Nelson requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted. With a roll call vote of 4 ayes and 6 nays, the motion did not prevail, and the A26
Amendment was not adopted.

Senator Klein moved that SF 1811 be recommended to pass as amended. Senator Klein requested a
roll call, and a roll call was granted. With a roll call vote of 8 ayes and 2 nays, the motion prevailed.

SF 1811 was recommended to pass as amended.

The meeting was adjourned at 7:46 p.m.

Present : Senator Jennifer A. McEwen - Chair, Senator Grant Hauschild - Vice Chair, Senator Gene Dornink, Senator Glenn H. Gruenhagen, Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Bill Lieske, Senator John Marty, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Sandra L. Pappas, Senator Nathan Wesenberg
 Absent : No Members Absent
 Senator Jennifer A. McEwen called the meeting to order at 12:41pm.
 S.F. 4125: Senator Dibble: Tending the Soil facility selecting planning and predesign appropriation. 
 The Labor Committee stands in recess pursuant to Senate Temporary Rule 12.5 at 12:42pm. 
 Chair McEwen called the committee back to order at 12:45pm. 
 Senator D. Scott Dibble presented Senate File 4125. 
 Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten moved the A-2 authors amendment. 
 The A-2 is adopted along a voice vote. 
 The following individuals testified in favor of SF 4125, as amended: 
 Rod Adams, the New Justice Project 
 Deborah Prokopf, Minnesota Training Partnership 
 Discussion. 
 Senator Glenn Gruenhagen offered the A-3 amendment. 
 Senator Dibble accepted the A-3 as a friendly amendment. 
 The A-3 amendment is adopted along a voice vote. 
 Discussion. 
 Cat Salonek Schladt, Executive Director of Tending the Soil answered member questions. 
 SF 4125, as amended, is laid over. 
 Gavel is passed to Vice Chair Grant Hauschild at 1:10pm 
Senator McEwen moved that S.F. 4125, as amended, be laid over.. - MOTION ADOPTED .
 S.F. 5266: Senator McEwen: Supplemental appropriations and other provisions modification related to the 
Bureau of Mediation Services. 
 Senator Jen McEwen presented Senate File 5266. 
 Senator McEwen moved the A-2 DE amendment. 
 The A-2 is adopted along a voice vote. 
 Senator McEwen moved the A-7 amendment. 
 Senate Council Carlon Doyle Fontaine walked through the A-7 amendment. 
 The A-7 is adopted along a voice vote. 
 Senator McEwen moved the A-16 amendment. 
 The A-16 amendment is adopted along a voice vote. 
 Erik Olafson, Senate Fiscal Analyst, walked through the change items in SF 5266. 
 The following individuals testified in favor of SF 5266, as amended: 
 Nicole Blissenbach, Commissioner of the Minnesota Department of Labor & Industry 
 Stephanie Spanja, Airline Pilots Association 
 Dr. Tracey Blasenhein, Employee, University of Minnesota 
 Ian Ringgenberg, Employee, University of Minnesota 
 Shae Horning, Government Affairs Coordinator, University of Minnesota, Undergraduate Student 
 Government 
 Jen Claseman, Labor Relations Director for the Minnesota Department of Management and Budget testified on concerns related to SF 5226. 
 Discussion. 
 Senator Gene Dornink offered the A-10 amendment. 
 Senator Dornink requested a roll call vote: 
 YEA: Hauschild, Dornink, Gruenhagen, Kupec, Lieske, Wesenberg 
 NAY: McEwen, Marty, Oumou Verbeten 
 Absent: Pappas 
 There being 6 yes votes and 3 no votes, the A-10 amendment is adopted. 
 Senator Dornink offered the A-9 amendment. 
 Senator Dornink requested a roll call vote: 
 YEA: Hauschilld, Dornink, Gruenhagen, Kupec, Lieske, Wesenberg. 
 NAY: McEwen, Marty, Oumou Verbeten, Pappas. 
 There being 6 yes votes, and 4 no votes, the A-9 amendment is adopted. 
 Senator Bill Lieske moved the A-15 amendment. 
 Mr. Ringgenberg rejoined to answer member questions. 
 Christopher Dale, Senior System Director of Labor Relations for Minnesota State Colleges & Universities joined the committee to answer member questions. 
 Mr. Dale rejoined to answer more member questions. 
 Meg Lugar-Nikolai, Attorney with Education Minnesota joined the committee to answer member questions. 
 Senator Lieske renewed his motion to adopt the A-15 amendment. 
 The A-15 amendment fails along a voice vote, and is not adopted. 
 Senator Gruenhagen offered the A-5 amendment 
 Senator Nathan Wesenberg moved an oral amendment to the A-5 amendment: 
 Line 1.4 strike "20,000,000" and insert "-0-". 
 Line 1.5 strike "20,000,000" and insert"...". 
 Senator Gruenhagen accepted the Wesenberg oral amendment as friendly. 
 The Wesenberg oral amendment is adopted along a voice vote to the A-5. 
 Senator Gruenhagen asked for a roll call vote: 
 YEA- Dornink, Gruenhagen, Lieske, Wesenberg 
 NAY- McEwen, Hauschild, Kupec, Marty, Oumou Verbeten, Pappas 
 There being 4 yes votes, and 6 no votes, the A-5, as amended, is not adopted. 
 Senator McEwen moved the A-12 amendment. 
 Senator Hauschild moved an oral amendment to the A-12 amendment. 
 Page 1, line 1.30 strike "develop" and insert "approve". 
 Senator McEwen accepted the Hauschild oral amendment as friendly. 
 The Hauschild oral amendment is adopted along a voice vote to the A-12. 
 Adam Hutchens, LiUNA Minnesota & North Dakota answered member questions related to the A-12 amendment. 
 Melissa Wolf, Executive Director of the Minnesota Cable Communications Association answered member questions related to the A-12 amendment. 
 Discussion. 
 Senator Dornink requested a roll call vote: 
 YEA- McEwen, Hauschild, Kupec, Marty, Oumou Verbeten, Pappas 
 NAY- Dornink, Gruenhagen, Lieske, Wesenberg 
 There being 6 yes votes and 4 no votes, the A-12 amendment, as amended is adopted. 
 Senator McEwen moved the A-3 amendment. 
 Senator Bill Lieske moved the A-14 amendment to the A-3 amendment. 
 Senator McEwen accepted the A-14 as a friendly amendment to the A-3. 
 The A-14 is adopted to the A-3 amendment on a voice vote. 
 Senator McEwen renewed her motion to adopt the A-3 amendment as amended. 
 The A-3, as amended, is adopted along a voice vote. 
 Senator Wesenberg moved the A-17 amendment. 
 Mr. Dale rejoined to answer member questions related to the A-17 amendment. 
 Senator Wesenberg requested a roll call vote: 
 YEA- Dornink, Gruenhagen, Lieske, Wesenberg 
 NAY- McEwen, Hauschild, Kupec, Marty, Oumou Verbeten, Pappas 
 There being 4 yes votes and 6 no votes, the A-17 amendment is not adopted. 
 Discussion. 
 SF 5226, as amended, is laid over. 
Senator Hauschild moved that S.F. 5266, as amended, be laid over.. - MOTION ADOPTED .
 The meeting was adjourned at 3:05pm.
Senator Grant Hauschild, Vice Chair
Jack Fischer, Legislative Assistant
